config.boundary: CSD 3542059 plus repository Owen Sound municipal boundary
config.coordinates: NAR BF representative point, falling back to building representative point

methodology: The June 2026 Statistics Canada National Address Register is the authoritative civic-address source. Residential and partly residential address units are published as separate address stops; LOC_GUID groups units at one physical location. Twelve records outside the repository municipal boundary and fourteen records without usable coordinates are excluded from the primary bundle. Building-footprint association remains a separate, reviewable layer; an unmatched NAR point is an explicit review point rather than an invented roof. No resident, owner, telephone, or roll-number fields are retained.
